messages:
Elaine CS: Heads up — renewal-risk dashboard showing a weird spike for the May trial cohort. I exported the list and ~40% look like duplicate trial accounts (SSO/email-aliasing). CSV: dupes_may.csv
Tom Onboarding: ugh that's noisy. Most of those have 0 product events but they completed signup so healthscore bumped them to 'active' and then 'no contact'.
Jamie Data: I pulled a quick query, looks like SSO_id is missing for a lot. We should group by canonical identity (coalesce(sso_id, lower(email))) and treat the group as one trial for scoring. SQL I ran:
```sql
with canonical as (
  select coalesce(sso_id, lower(email)) as canonical_id, min(created_at) as first_seen, array_agg(id) as account_ids
  from accounts
  where created_at >= '2025-05-01'
  group by 1
)
select canonical_id, first_seen, cardinality(account_ids) as count from canonical order by count desc limit 50;
```
Jamie Data: Proposal: add `trial_family_id` (hash of canonical_id) and update the healthscore rule to count at most one trial per family. Also tag duplicates for manual follow-up so CS doesn't waste time.
Sara Ops: Love it. Operationally we can run a nightly job to populate `trial_family_id` and set `is_duplicate=true` for the extra accounts. Those flagged accounts would be excluded from renewal-risk and onboarding automation.
Elaine CS: Can we also tweak the playbook triggers? Right now playbook fires when `trial_count_org > 1` which is wrong if duplicates. Change to `distinct_trial_families > 1`.
Tom Onboarding: I'll open CST ticket and PR for the healthscore service and playbook changes. Assigning to @Jamie Data and @Elaine CS. ETA: EOD tomorrow for PR, rollout early next week.
Jamie Data: I'll add a Grafana panel: `dup_trial_ratio` and an alert (warn if > 0.05). Also will add a backfill job for historical cohorts.
Elaine CS: Small UX ask — add a lightweight post-signup micro-survey for suspected duplicates: "Did someone else at your org already create an account?" 1-click yes/no. Helps us capture cause (SSO vs personal alias).
Sara Ops: We'll wire the survey response into the ticket payload so CS sees causation when we surface duplicates.
Tom Onboarding: For rollout plan: 1) nightly dedupe job (non-blocking), 2) backfill & update healthscore in staging, 3) deploy playbook change behind feature flag, 4) monitor metrics (dup ratio, renewal-risk delta), 5) flip flag.
Elaine CS: Sounds good. Also please add a short note in the onboarding runbook so new hires know why duplicates might be marked.
DeployBot: nightly-dedupe-job scheduled for 2025-07-22T02:00:00Z (job id: ndj-20250722-01) :white_check_mark:
OpsBot: Created ticket CST-342: "trial-family dedupe + healthscore rule update" assigned to Tom Onboarding, Jamie Data, Elaine CS.
Tom Onboarding: I'll follow up w/ PR link once it's up. Thanks all :raised_hands:
Jamie Data: Quick follow-up — if anyone wants the query or sample export let me know, I'll share via Google Drive link.
Elaine CS: Thanks team. Hoping this cleans up renewal signals before next Q review.
